name: Garay Gardens and Orchards
description: Garay Gardens and Orchards is an independent orchard in Quincy, WA. It grows Raspberries, Squash, Tomatoes, Peppers, and Herbs, with picking through summer. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Jun – Sep in this growing zone.
